steps.do: Create lena and sam under Accounts (password cookbook08-lab-passphrase), create a workspace with the top bar +, and add both as Reviewer under Project access. The server must list lena in CALIBER_APPROVER_USERS.

The manifest's deploy gate names a test set. Import it before that test set exists: Import, type a name, Choose file incident-commander.workflow.json (with artifacts.eval_datasets.incident-cases.dataset_name set to the name you will use), Validate dependencies.
steps.see: Preflight needs attention and is not visible in this workspace: the import is refused until the test set exists.

steps.do: Press + New Test Set, type the name from the manifest, owner @lab08, Create, open it and press + Add example three times, pasting the input and expected of IN01, IN03 and IN06 and their tags. (The API path loads all 41 rows; the form adds one at a time.)
steps.see: The test set lists three example rows.

steps.do: Import again with the same file and name, Validate dependencies, then Import as new.
steps.see: Preflight passed; the editor opens with severity_table, action_table, join, triage_router and review in the outline.

steps.do: Press Validate, then Preview, paste the IN01 incident and press Run Preview, and open the summarize step. Unlike a Python Code workflow, this one previews.
steps.see: The toolbar says Valid.; the preview is completed and the summarize step shows sev1 rollback.
The toolbar says Published. The alpha UI has no Deployments or Promotions tab: the staging and gated prod aliases, the deploy gate and rollback are API only.

steps.do: Open Run Monitor, paste an incident ({"incident": {...}}) and press Run. Run IN06 (healthy staging), then IN01 (gateway regression after a deploy). Then press Approve on the IN01 run as the same account.
steps.see: IN06 completes with RECOMMENDATION and sev4 monitor. IN01 stops at waiting_approval; Approve as the starter shows a second person must decide.

steps.do: Sign in as lena, choose the workspace, open Workflows, the workflow and its Runs tab, select the run that shows Awaiting approval, press Approve, then Resume.
steps.see: The run's output contains ROLLBACK_APPROVED and the sev1 rollback verdict. (Evaluations can also score a Workflow version as the subject, at most 20 examples per run; with the simulated provider it answers 400 evaluation requires a real LLM provider.)
